items.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Could Be 21% Above Fair Value After ClickHouse Expansion
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) just deepened its ties with ClickHouse, extending the analytics partner’s presence across Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Azure and the Microsoft Marketplace. For anyone tracking Microsoft stock, this alliance sharpens the firm’s broader data and AI story. Recent price action has been choppy for Microsoft. The shares are around US$508.96 after a 90-day share price return of 32.45%. The 1-year total shareholder return is slightly negative, which points to strong short-term momentum...

items.title: Was There Any Sign Palantir Stock Would Run?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) stock returned 60.3% in the three months from June 30 to September 29, 2026. A $10,000 holding at the start of that window was worth about $16,030 at the end. The run came from faster sales growth, led by the U.S. business, and Palantir reports that growth every quarter. Could you have seen that growth coming before June 30.
